abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Inspected /saisdata/37 target PDBs by derived metadata only: each file is a header-stripped single protein chain with no non-water co-crystal HETATM ligand recorded in the local file. RCSB sequence search mapped target1 to human MCL1 (Q07820; 4HW2/4HW3/4HW4/4ZBF/4ZBI), target2 to human TYK2 JH2 pseudokinase (P29597; 3ZON/4OLI/4WOV/5TKD), and target3 to GPR119/glucose-dependent insulinotropic receptor (Q8TDV5; 7XZ5/7XZ6/8VHF/8ZR5/8ZRK/9L79). Known ligand families: MCL1 acidic indole/benzothiophene/tricyclic carboxylates in a BH3 hydrophobic groove; TYK2 JH2 urea/benzamide/imidazopyrrolopyridine allosteric inhibitors with polar kinase-like contacts; GPR119 lipophilic GPCR agonists such as APD668, MBX-2982, firuglipel, and GSK-1292263 with heteroaryl/piperidine/sulfonyl or oxadiazole motifs.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: No manifest.csv was present in the project listing. Representative source URLs: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4HW2, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4WOV, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/7XZ6, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/8VHF, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/8ZRK. Representative PubChem CIDs resolved from RCSB InChIKeys: 19H CID 70680244, 3SM CID 24825710, A1D8Y CID 24996872. Baseline failure modes from this context: high-logP polyaromatic amides are not TYK2/GPR119-like and lack the MCL1 acidic anchor, but they may still score well in the local whole-protein Vina proxy.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Explored two target-specific improvement paths. Public co-crystal ligand controls used MCL1 19H, TYK2 3SM/BMS-066, and GPR119 GSK-1292263/A1D8Y as docking controls; they were rejected because tier 0 ok_count was 0/3 from rotors_gt_4 and/or tpsa_outside_28_88, routes were only element-balance controls, and tier 2 Vina did not beat baseline on the local target boxes. A route-constrained Suzuki/amide generated-top1 subset from the shipped chemistry passed route/RDKit checks but did not decisively improve the fallback: target3 fell to official_weighted_proxy_score 82.6281 and affinity -8.09, target2 had worse affinity (-13.67 vs baseline -14.82) despite a tiny proxy tie-breaker gain, and target1 was only marginally higher proxy with slightly worse affinity.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: No molecule change was made. Final archive is a conservative copy of baseline_result.zip at /work/targetmol/run/agent/candidate/result.zip. Validation evidence: Python zipfile member order ok; CSV parsing ok; each CSV one row and one unique SMILES; each route final product matches mol_smiles literally and by RDKit canonicalization; offline_eval final_t1 ok_count 3/3; offline_eval final_t2 ok_count 3/3, failure_count 0, official_weighted_proxy_score_mean 85.0848, min 84.7907. Evidence files are under experiments/eval_final_t1, experiments/eval_final_t2, experiments/eval_known_ligands_t2, and experiments/eval_generated_top1_t2.
